knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The listing states the feature as it is, so the guest is not misled.
A price outside the owner limit needs the owner's approval first.
A factual reply is given once, and false claims go through the platform process. Inducements and public arguments are not used.

practicalCriteria: Assessor gives a property record and asks the candidate to mark which listing claims need a limit stated
Assessor checks a price change record for date, reason and owner-limit check
Assessor reviews a draft review reply for factual content and absence of any inducement
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Listing claim check against the property record
Price change log for one change
stopWorkCriteria: A listing claim is published without a property record entry
A price is changed outside the owner limit without approval
A review is answered with an offer of money or a free night
